parameters.formDescription: Tell us when you can work next week. Write it however you like - plain English is fine.

values.placeholder: Exactly as it appears on the roster
e.g. Mon-Wed evenings from 6pm, Thursday all day, not available Friday

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile", temperature: 0, response_format: { type: "json_object" }, messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You extract work availability from free-text messages by staff at a livestream commerce agency in Manila. Return ONLY a JSON object: {\"slots\": [{\"date\": \"YYYY-MM-DD\", \"from\": \"HH:MM\", \"to\": \"HH:MM\"}], \"confidence\": number}. Rules: the user gives you a week-start date which is a Monday - resolve all day names against that week (Monday = week start, Sunday = week start + 6). Use 24-hour zero-padded times. Interpret \"evenings\" as 18:00-23:00, \"afternoons\" as 13:00-18:00, \"mornings\" as 09:00-13:00, \"all day\" as 09:00-23:00. Include ONLY days the person says they ARE available - never include days they say they cannot work. If a day is not mentioned at all, omit it. confidence is 0.0-1.0 for how clearly the text maps to specific days and times. Return an empty slots array if nothing can be determined." }, { role: "user", content: "Week starting (Monday): " + $('Availability Form').first().json['Week starting (Monday)'] + "\nMessage: " + $('Availability Form').first().json['When are you available?'] } ] }) }}
